questions.text: Describe how you would set up Marketo programs. (Mandatory)

lines.name: Instance, tracking and email domain setup

sections: We would deliver this with Marketo Engage.

We will complete the initial setup steps and protocols, set up SPF and DKIM, the CNAMEs for branded tracking links and landing pages, install the Munchkin code on the website, and set up users and roles.

We will agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.
We will train the marketing users on programs, smart campaigns and templates, and document the new instance setup so the team can run it after launch.
Each month we will review Admin, Marketing Activities, Design Studio and Database for clean-up, deliverability and scoring changes, and agree the fixes with your Marketo owner.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Marketo Engage.

What we would do
- We will complete the initial setup steps and protocols, set up SPF and DKIM, the CNAMEs for branded tracking links and landing pages, install the Munchkin code on the website, and set up users and roles.
- We will agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.
- We will train the marketing users on programs, smart campaigns and templates, and document the new instance setup so the team can run it after launch.

After launch
- Each month we will review Admin, Marketing Activities, Design Studio and Database for clean-up, deliverability and scoring changes, and agree the fixes with your Marketo owner.

Sources
- Experience League: Auditing an inherited Marketo Engage instance: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo-learn/auditing-an-inherited-instance/audit-an-inherted-instance
- Experience League: Plan for a new Marketo Engage implementation: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experiences-by-you/implementing-new-instance/planning-for-new-implementation
- Experience League: Sync fields for the native CRM connectors: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experiences-by-you/implementing-new-instance/syncing-fields-for-crm-integration
- Getting started with Salesforce sync: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo-learn/tutorials/integrations/salesforce-sync-setup
- Understanding the Microsoft Dynamics Sync: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo/using/product-docs/crm-sync/microsoft-dynamics/understanding-the-microsoft-dynamics-sync
